items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: you see he had a big banjo player named George.

ctx.x: I see. And what about Rene Parker? Did you ever know him?

Oh yeah, I worked with him. I'm going to tell you who I worked with Rene Parker. I used to go down in Platinum, he talks Creole, French. Yeah, I see. Sing French. You know him singing, he was a boy and all that. I used to, you see he had a big banjo player named George. Mm-hmm. And that banjo player died. He started taking me and Walter. Walter Nelson. Mm-hmm.
